item.title: Thimphu
item.description: Thimphu, the capital and largest city of Bhutan Thimphu is the capital and largest city of the Kingdom of Bhutan. Located in western Bhutan, the city lies in a scenic valley along the Wang Chhu river and serves as the political, administrative, and cultural center of the country. Population As of the early 2020s, Thimphu had an estimated population of around 115,000 people, making it the most populous city in Bhutan.
